rdf:Description.dc:title: Archie Alphonso Alexander
rdf:Description.dc:description: Archie Alexander was an African American engineer from Iowa and the senior partner in the firm Alexander and Repass. In the 1940s, the firm was hired to build a bridge and seawall at the Tidal Basin. Alexander spearheaded the project and brought in an integrated construction crew.
